verdict.rationale: Workflow automation is a fair axis for a team chat tool, but the evidence shows no native no-code workflow builder in Zulip with event, schedule, or form-submission triggers. What it does show is a code-based bot framework (a developer building block) and automation through third-party Zapier/IFTTT (external tools). Neither counts as the product's own no-code workflow capability.

support.subject: As a team-admin, I can build no-code workflows triggered by events, schedules, or form submissions inside the chat tool

citations.quote: You can write and run a custom bot, or run an existing Zulip bot.
And hundreds more through Zapier and IFTTT.
